assumptions: Original qid operation order retained; one parent and one uncommitted edge per qid.
PQ partitions are nonpreemptive through read/compare/write feedback, finite bank ports; partition conflict is explicit wait.
Heap level requires three stages; PQ launch/finish adds 2(push)/5(pop).
Edge pipe II1 and feedback7 eligible/3 discarded; metadata/FP32/label and commit included.
One reset write/context/cycle; output nc+8/context; no overlapped graph reload.
Not a universal lower bound: different microarchitecture can reduce work. Memory latency and HLS global recurrence may make real RTL slower.
